FN-SH2K77-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 138
Committee: Banking and Insurance Sponsor: Senator Shay Shelnutt
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/03/2023
Senate Bill 138 as introduced would reduce the obligations of the Department of Insurance by
an estimated $5,000 annually due to the reduction in fees related to notice of certain hearings.
